'sby' is the stronger strategy for the state-holding q register partition. It is listed alone, so no weaker 'sat' strategy can take over a partition.\n\nExpected compare points:\n- The register q[3:0] must match through its next-state logic. Gold uses an adder (q+1 or q-1). Gate uses the toggle chain q ^ {&same[2:0], &same[1:0], same[0], 1}.\n- carry must match. Gold computes q==15. Gate computes &same with up=1, which is the same condition.\n- borrow must match. Gold computes q==0. Gate computes &(~q) with up=0, which is the same condition.\n- The internal gate nets same, chain and edge_hit have no gold counterpart. They are expected to be unmatched internal nets, not unmatched outputs.\n\nStatus: no result is reported here. === FILE: updown_counter_equiv.eqy ===
[gold]
read_verilog updown_counter.v
prep -top updown_counter

[gate]
read_verilog updown_counter_refactor.v
prep -top updown_counter

[strategy sby]
use sby
depth 20
engine smtbmc
=== END FILE ===
